name: Nairobi Business Ventures Plc
source: Nairobi Business Ventures Plc unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 September 2025 (first half of the financial year ending 31 March 2026), group column, read from the issuer published PDF at nbvplc.com/UNAUDITED%202025.pdf, signed by Chief Executive Officer Haresh Soni and dated 28 November 2025. Unit KES. Group sales 137,527,000 (September 2024: 280,509,000), direct and other operating costs 81,402,000 (218,580,000), gross profit 56,125,000 (61,929,000), administrative and other costs 134,403,000 (160,965,000), loss before tax and after tax 78,278,000 (99,036,000). No finance cost, tax charge or earnings per share line is printed in the interim summary, so those rows stay empty apart from a nil tax charge the statement prints as a dash.
source_note: Absolute Kenya Shillings (Shs). Company (parent) statements. Consolidated group figures are also disclosed (group sales KES 508.0m 2025 / 809.8m 2024) but no consolidated cash flow is published. Other income is nil in 2025. FY2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-nbv-2026-ab-00/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. MAGNITUDE: a period figure that was less than 5 percent of the prior annual column was withheld as unit-suspect; it is blank rather than rescaled. | H1 2026 column filled 12 Nov 2026 from the issuer interim PDF; the group income statement prints sales, direct and other operating costs, gross profit, administrative and other costs, profit before tax, a nil tax charge and profit after tax. Cross-checked against the same figures reported by the period press coverage (sales KES 137.5m, loss after tax KES 78.3m).
